definitions.full: H6015. amar עֲמַר noun masculine wool ( ᵑ7 Syriac; Egyptian Aramaic עמר S-C G7, 10 , קמר Id. H 5 ; compare Mandean אקאמרא , Nö M 72 ; see Biblical Hebrew צמר ); — absolute Dan 7:9 .
